background: Yuan Jie’s poem on the suppression of the An Lushan rebellion, cut into a cliff at Wuxi and written out by Yan Zhenqing at 63. The provincial page calls it the foremost of the surviving “three excellences” inscriptions.

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft work record from two government pages. Their character counts disagree, so the count is recorded as disputed rather than chosen.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：依据两份政府页面整理的草稿；两处字数记载不一致，故记为有争议而非择一。

notes: The Hunan page and the Yongzhou page disagree on the character count (242 vs 332).
